parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex sinus rhythm with normal axis, normal QRS and PR, and upright T waves. There is only mild concave J-point elevation in V2-V4, with no convex or tombstone ST elevation and no reciprocal ST depression, so I see no STEMI on this tracing even though this case turned out to be one.
